hypothesis: Frozen CT forecasts retain practically useful price-direction information when transported with beta1 to the origin-known second contract, rather than measuring CT front-proxy switches. No same-target retraining inference.
primary: T5 numeric_D0 raw vs same-contract Naive
secondary: T5 selected companion,paired numeric_D0 vs mask_D0 source attribution; T1 selected/raw diagnostic; no T1 rescue of T5
contract_rule: D0 latest assumed-available report at original decision; select second_contract then hold exact name fixed. No future contract identity.
label_rule: contemporaneous reference-day origin quote available_by_decision; future same-name target quote at original Cotton targetdate; no filling/substitution.
availability: max(report_date,unverified publication calendar day)+1 day00:00UTC; age<=3 Cotton observations; final vintage assumed,NOT admitted
baseline: named_origin_price; no stale available_quote variant and no old-proxy baseline score
cohort: All749 original receipts retained;739 paired eligible per horizon,10 explicit missing/ineligible; preserve252/251/246 Cotton ordinals and original targetdates
selection: No fitting/reselection/calibration; original past selected weights frozen

bootstrap.method: year-preserving moving-block recentered basic; full749 ordinal slots, zero bookkeeping contributions for missing with weight0, divide by resampled eligible weight; fixed observed comparator MAE normalization. No synthetic zero-error labels, no calendar compression.

sensitivity: Remove ceil(1% of739)=8 largest same-contract Naive errors; ties stable origin order; same removal for both arms/modes per horizon. Descriptive,not new selection.

decision_rules.strong_candidate: Primary RAW gain>=5%,direction>=55%,all3 observed years won,both20/60 CIs lower>0; named-target follow-up candidate only,not unchanged6/8 gate or PIT proof. Selected companion reported separately with flats and active-rate semantics.
decision_rules.fixed_transport_below_goal: Both primary RAW20/60 gain CI uppers<5%; fixed frozen-return transport does not rescue the practical target. Does not reject named-target retraining or all capacities.
decision_rules.not_tested: Retrained named-target models,all sources/model capacities or production skill

limits: Reviewed2021-23 development evidence,not independent holdout; clock/vintage assumed; missingness bias not repaired by bootstrap; price field is printed AMS future quote, not proven executable settlement/fill. No trade,source admission,newdata,promotion,gate change.
